description: A brief look at the mystery of the missing princes of the Tower.

facts.claim: In June 1483, Edward IV placed his sons Edward V and Richard, Duke of York, in the Tower of London.
Richard, Duke of Gloucester, was appointed Lord Protector of the realm in September 1483.
The two princes were last seen in February 1484 and then disappeared.
A 2021 study of contemporary accounts suggests Richard may have fled the Tower rather than murdering the princes.
